title: Schedule of Visit Time Measures — Personal Services Plan
content:
This schedule fixes, for every tier of the Personal Services Plan, the units in which personal service time is measured: the billing increment to which delivered time is rounded up, the minimum hours drawn or billed per service visit, the minimum hours drawn or billed per companion visit, the longest single visit that may be booked, and the hours equivalent of the unit-priced hourly services.

## Schedule

| Tier | Billing increment (minutes) | Minimum per visit (hours) | Minimum per companion visit (hours) | Maximum per booked visit (hours) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Personal Services Pay-As-You-Go Plan | 15 | 1.0 | 1.0 | 4 |
| Personal Services Essentials Package | 15 | 0.5 | 1.0 | 4 |
| Personal Services Companion Package | 15 | 0.5 | 1.0 | 4 |
| Personal Services Comfort Package | 15 | 0.5 | 1.0 | 4 |
| Personal Services Premier Package | 15 | 0.5 | 1.0 | 4 |
| Personal Services Concierge Package | 15 | 0.5 | 1.0 | 4 |

## Unit-priced hourly services

Two hourly services are priced per unit and converted into hours, identically on every tier:

| Unit | Hours per unit (all tiers) |
|---|---|
| One laundry load | 0.5 |
| One linen change | 0.25 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The companion visit minimum of 1.0 hour applies regardless of package; the minimum per visit for other hourly services is 1.0 hour on the Pay-As-You-Go Plan and 0.5 hour on each of the five packages.
- The billing increment is 15 minutes on every tier, so a quarter hour is the smallest step of measured time.
- Hypothetical conversion: three laundry loads correspond to 1.5 hours (three multiplied by 0.5), and two linen changes to 0.5 hour (two multiplied by 0.25).
